That is markup and outline formatting. The standard's text and meaning are unchanged. Under this verification's rules, a difference that is only formatting does not count. The outline inconsistency is real in the markdown (specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md line 4376 '## 3.3' under line 4304 '### 3.' on the same page run; 3.2.4.2 at ### beside 3.2.4.1 at #### shows the same pattern), so a heading-level normalization pass may want it. It is not a content discrepancy against the PDF.
